unit.1.one: Kills the Senapati and the Maharathi — but only if it strikes first.
unit.1.desc: Moves 1 cell. If it attacks first it slays the Senapati (10) or the Maharathi (9), whatever the hour. Against anything else it loses.
unit.1.tip: Hold it for the endgame, then trade it for a commander.
unit.2.one: Slides across open lanes and can strike in the same turn.
unit.2.desc: Slides any number of open cells along a lane and may attack in the same turn. A run of 2 or more cells reveals it.
unit.2.tip: Crossing the field reveals you — run late, not early.
unit.3.one: The only piece that can clear a trap. Do not waste it.
unit.3.desc: Moves 1 cell. The only piece that can dismantle a Shataghni trap and take its cell.
unit.3.tip: Your trap-clearer is also your best cheap probe.
unit.5.one: Reveals an enemy within two cells without a fight.
unit.5.desc: Moves 1 cell, or looks: permanently reveals any enemy within 2 cells without fighting.
unit.5.tip: Information is tempo. Look before you strike.
unit.6.one: Shoots two cells away without moving. Your safe probe.
unit.6.desc: Moves 1 cell, or looses a rain of arrows at exactly 2 cells, over anything in between. Cuts down rank 5 or less without moving.
unit.6.tip: The only piece that kills without moving — and it cannot be hurt by the reply.
unit.7.one: Fast flanker. Rushes two cells and strikes at the end.
unit.7.desc: Moves up to 2 open cells along a lane and may strike at the end of the dash. A 2-cell dash reveals it.
unit.7.tip: Reaches the second line of a formation in one tempo.
unit.9.one: Second strongest — beats everything except the Senapati.
unit.9.desc: Moves 1 cell. Only the Senapati outranks it, and an attacking Chara can fell it. In its own hour, with a pincer, it can topple the Senapati.
unit.9.tip: A bodyguard for your fort: strong enough to absorb probes.
unit.10.one: Strongest piece on the field. Keep it hidden, then commit it.
unit.10.desc: Moves 1 cell. Beats every piece in a straight fight — but a Chara that strikes first can kill it, and so can a pincer in the enemy’s hour.
unit.10.tip: Keep it behind a screen until the enemy Chara is spent.
unit.B.one: Immovable trap. Kills anything that hits it, except the engineer.
unit.B.desc: Immovable. Destroys any piece that attacks it, and survives — unless that piece is a Yantrik. Fire (Agneyastra) also burns it.
unit.B.tip: A trap only works once. Hide it where a probe must pass.
unit.F.one: Your fort. Its gate breaks on the first blow; the second blow takes it.
unit.F.desc: Immovable. The first successful blow breaks its gate and reveals it; the second takes it and ends the match. A volley counts as a blow.
unit.F.tip: Never leave it where an archer has a clear two-cell lane.
astra.vayavya.one: Swap any two of your own pieces.
astra.vayavya.desc: A wind sweeps the field and two of your pieces change places — even the fort. Both stay hidden.
astra.sammohana.one: Entrance an enemy piece for two turns.
astra.sammohana.desc: Pick an enemy piece within two cells of any of yours. It cannot move or act on its owner’s next two turns. It still defends.
astra.agneya.one: Burn a piece of rank 4 or less.
astra.agneya.desc: Pick an enemy piece within two cells of any of yours. It is revealed; rank 4 or less (and any Shataghni) burns. A fort’s gate burns open.
astra.brahma.desc: Pick an enemy fighting piece within two cells of any of yours. Nothing withstands it, and everything around it is revealed. The fort and the trap are beyond it.
hour.day.one: The hour of Surya — Suryavansh strikes at +1.
hour.night.one: The hour of Chandra — Chandravansh strikes at +1.
formation.makara.one: Jaws: strike a piece that another of yours already touches — +1.
formation.padma.one: Petals: a piece touched by two of its friends defends at +1.
board.wheel.blurb: the wheel · the rings turn every 5 rounds
board.padma.blurb: the lotus · six exits, the rings turn
opponent.recruit.blurb: A young soldier. Brave, greedy, forgets your threats.
opponent.veteran.blurb: The teacher. Reads your formation, punishes loose pieces.
opponent.archon.blurb: The schemer. Sees your best reply — and waits for your mistake.
scenario.duel.blurb: Two equal armies of twelve. Break the enemy fort.
scenario.abhimanyu.blurb: Eight raiders must break into a closed wheel of ten before round 28.
lesson.move.title: Move
lesson.move.text: Tap your Rath (2) on the left, then tap a glowing cell up the open lane.
lesson.look.title: Look before you strike
lesson.look.text: Tap the Divyadrishti (5), press Drishti, then tap a hidden enemy. It is revealed without a fight.
lesson.volley.title: Rain of arrows
lesson.volley.text: Tap the Dhanurdhar (6), press Volley, then tap the enemy exactly two cells ahead.
lesson.strike.title: Strike
lesson.strike.text: Your Maharathi (9) beats almost anything. Tap it, tap the enemy beside it to see your odds, then tap again to strike.
lesson.trap.title: The trap
lesson.trap.text: Pieces that never move may be a trap or the fort. Only a Yantrik (3) clears a trap. Walk yours up the right and strike the still piece.
lesson.gate.title: Take the fort
lesson.gate.text: The last still piece is their fort. In a real battle its gate breaks on the first blow — here, one blow takes it.

daily.nightfall.one: The defence holds the first hour.

daily.restless.name: The wheel is restless

daily.open.name: The gate is open
daily.open.one: The fort’s gate is already broken — but the defence holds three Shakti.
daily.sharad.name: Sharad patience
daily.sharad.one: You have 28 rounds, but the defenders begin with one Shakti.
daily.hemant.name: Hemant watch

daily.grishma.name: Grishma haste
daily.grishma.one: You have 22 rounds and three starting Shakti.
daily.varsha.name: Varsha wheel
daily.varsha.one: The rings turn every four rounds, with 26 rounds to finish.
daily.diya.name: Lamps at dusk
daily.diya.one: Both armies begin with two Shakti.
daily.patang.name: Kite wind
daily.patang.one: The rings turn every three rounds; you begin with three Shakti.
daily.rang.name: Colours of spring
daily.rang.one: Both armies begin with three Shakti.
daily.monsoon-night.name: Monsoon night
daily.monsoon-night.one: Night comes first and the rings turn every four rounds.
daily.long-watch.name: Long watch
daily.long-watch.one: You have 30 rounds against defenders with two starting Shakti.
daily.last-lamp.name: Last lamp
daily.last-lamp.one: The raiders begin with one Shakti and have 28 rounds.
daily.swift-dawn.name: Swift dawn
daily.swift-dawn.one: The rings turn every three rounds, with 28 rounds to finish.
daily.chariot-road.name: Chariot road
daily.chariot-road.one: The raiders exchange their Divyadrishti for a third Rath.
daily.engineers-path.name: Engineers’ path
daily.engineers-path.one: A second Yantrik replaces one of your two Rath.
daily.cavalry-road.name: Cavalry road
daily.cavalry-road.one: A second Ashvarohi replaces one of your two Rath.
daily.two-shadows.name: Two shadows
daily.two-shadows.one: A second Chara replaces one of your two Rath.
daily.night-reserve.name: Night reserve
daily.night-reserve.one: Night comes first; both armies begin with one Shakti.
daily.turning-petal.name: Turning petal
daily.turning-petal.one: The rings turn every six rounds; each side begins with one Shakti.

home.lesson.sub: Learn the field in two minutes
battle.tap_hint: Tap a piece, then a glowing cell. Or invoke an astra.
battle.tap_again: Tap the target again to strike.
share.cta: Abhimanyu got in. Can you get out?
